actions.action: Wipe dusty film off leaves with a damp cloth
Check top 3–5 cm of soil and water thoroughly only when dry, then empty saucer
Check that pots, including the black inner pot, have drainage holes
Move plants away from cold glass, drafts and radiators
Move plants to the brightest available spot
Raise humidity with a pebble tray or by grouping plants
Cut fully brown leaves off at the base if they turn brown
Check leaf undersides for webbing or specks (spider mites)
Watch for yellowing lower leaves, sour smell or soft stem base (root rot)

reason: The answer leads with repotting stress but lists cold drafts only as a fourth cause alongside humidity and watering. Its advice to avoid cold glass and be patient is present but buried among many other tips, and nothing in it is harmful.
